title: Delivery metrics
description: Delivery, bounce and complaint rates for mail sent through MepMail in the last 30 days. Rates only, updated hourly.
lead: What the platform measures about its own mail: delivery, bounce and complaint rates over a rolling 30-day window. Rates only, never absolute volume.

rates.deliveryNote: Delivered, opened or clicked, out of every resolved email.
rates.bounceNote: Bounced, out of every resolved email.
rates.complaintNote: Marked as spam, out of every resolved email.

insufficient.title: Not enough data in this window
insufficient.body: Too few emails resolved in the last 30 days for a rate to mean anything, so no rate is published.

unavailable.title: Numbers unavailable right now
unavailable.body: The metrics could not be read at this moment. This page shows the numbers again once a read succeeds, and never an estimate.

methodology.title: How these numbers are produced
points: Last 30 days, rolling: every email created in the window counts, nothing older.
Rates only: this page never publishes absolute volume, per-customer or per-domain numbers.
Accounts suspended for abuse are excluded from every count.

The platform's own transactional mail (account verification, password resets and account notices) counts too: it goes through the same pipeline and sending infrastructure as customer mail, and it can be a large share of the total while customer volume is small.
Canceled and unsent emails are excluded: they were never attempted, so they are not delivery failures.
Resolved emails are the denominator: delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained and failed.
Updated hourly: one database read serves the page for an hour.
methodology.note: HTTP availability is measured separately, on the service status page.
